title: Port Mirroring (SPAN)
description: Configure SPAN to copy traffic from one port to a monitoring port.
scenario: Configure SPAN to copy traffic from one port to a monitoring port.

concepts.title: SPAN
concepts.body: SPAN (Switched Port Analyzer) copies traffic from source ports to a destination port for monitoring.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# monitor session 1 source interface FastEthernet0/1
SW1(config)# monitor session 1 destination interface FastEthernet0/24

concepts.title: Use Cases
concepts.body: Traffic analysis, intrusion detection, packet capture with Wireshark, and troubleshooting.

concepts.title: Verifying SPAN
concepts.body: "show monitor session 1" shows source and destination ports.
concepts.code:
SW1# show monitor session 1
Session 1
Source Ports: Fa0/1
Destination Ports: Fa0/24
